Title: UKDebugDocker
Overview: A KDebugDocker is a premade class made to present menus in the KDebug system to users at runtime. It is also able to create popout windows for separating debug menus from the game window. A default DebugDocker already exists, but the class is available for creating your own version of the widget if desired. Apply any custom DebugDocker in Project Settings > Plugins > KDebug Tools Settings > Debug Docker
